meta.title: Retention
meta.joinKey: Printavo Customer ID  ·  Sale box 1068  ↔  Retention box 1003
meta.howToMaintain: Edit this file only. The page renders itself from it. When a workflow flips state, change its node.status here and (if it's an alarm) update the alarms[] array.

alarms.title: ④ Save-Touch is OFF
alarms.detail: The AT-Risk save-email/call engine is INACTIVE + DRY_RUN. Every 'we miss you' touch is sent by hand today. This is the single biggest automation hole.
alarms.action: Later sprint: ~2-day ② Open-Deal Guard burn-in → activate + set DRY_RUN=false. First run = ~27 backlog tasks.

alarms.title: System B dies 2026-09-12
alarms.detail: The ~305-day annual reorder email lives in Automations.io on the Printavo integration token, which expires 2026-09-12. Its firing is UNCONFIRMED — we can't tell from our side if it sends.
alarms.action: Verify it fires; migrate the annual reorder email into n8n before the token expires.

alarms.title: A, B, and C don't talk
alarms.detail: Three cadence engines run in parallel. System A (n8n) can mark a customer LOST while System C (manual bandana ladder) is still hand-emailing them an annual reorder. No single cadence source of truth exists.
alarms.action: Absorb B + C into A ('formalize what already works'). Stated intent; not yet done.

alarms.title: System C has no engine
alarms.detail: The bandana 'Annual Check-In' ladder (1st check-in → /nc4 4-month → /reorderban reorder) is 100% manual Streak tasks in Shara's inbox. Copy exists (Scripts/Retention.csv); nothing fires it.
alarms.action: Highest-leverage build: an auto-send layer that reads the Retention pipeline.

alarms.title: Daily Recompute may time out
alarms.detail: Drift audit (7/2): the nightly recompute risks hitting n8n's 300s execution cap on a full Printavo history pull → a partial re-band that night.
alarms.action: Paginate or shard the recompute so it can't exceed the cap.

alarms.title: Open-Deal Guard stage gaps
alarms.detail: Drift audit (7/2): the Guard's suppression stage-set omits several live Sale stages (5022, 5013…). Once ④ Save-Touch goes live, a mid-quote customer in those stages could get a cold 'save' touch.
alarms.action: Add the missing Sale stage IDs to ② Open-Deal Guard before flipping ④ live.

alarms.title: 2 crons are mislabeled
alarms.detail: ③ Enrich node says '2am PT' but fires 6am PT. Relabel node says '~6am PT' but fires 10am PT. Behavior is fine; the labels lie, so the cadence map on the wall won't match reality.
alarms.action: 30-second rename of the two schedule nodes in n8n.

alarms.title: North Star has one stale clause
alarms.detail: The 5/21 sales-team walk-through softened 'Both → Cortney' from an auto-transfer to auto-flip-with-manual-override. The North Star doc (the tie-breaker) was never updated to match.
alarms.action: One-line reconciliation in the strategy layer.

systems.name: n8n Retention lifecycle
systems.summary: Enrich → Convert → band → AT-Risk save, across the Sale + Retention pipelines. Data-true and mostly automated. Every node below except System B/C rows is System A.

systems.name: Automations.io / Printavo emails
systems.summary: Form-to-Printavo, quote chasing, invoice approval, post-delivery review request, and a ~305-day annual reorder email — all Printavo-triggered, outside n8n.
systems.flag: Annual reorder firing UNCONFIRMED · integration token expires 2026-09-12

systems.name: Manual bandana task ladder
systems.summary: The 'Annual Check-In' tasks in Shara's inbox. Hand-created Streak tasks on Sale-pipeline boxes — 1st check-in → 4-month → annual reorder — laddered forward by hand on each order.
systems.flag: Task creation, email send, AND cadence-reset all manual. This is the inbox backlog.

cadence.items: ④ AT-Risk Save-Touch — OFF, fires nothing
Web Intake (form submit) · Fix Agent (any workflow failure)

nodes.name: Web Intake
nodes.what: Creates the Sale box, stamps Intake = Form, sets first Relationship Status

nodes.name: Pass 1 · PM-Box Enrich
nodes.what: Stamps Intake = Direct; name-matches Printavo → Customer ID, $, city. Confidence Gate (7/2) writes CID only on a strong match, else skips + Chat alert.
nodes.next: Fuzzy matcher is the weakest link in the fleet — watch it.

nodes.name: ② Open-Deal Guard
nodes.trigger: on quote · while a deal is live
nodes.what: Stamps Date of Last Quote or Activity; suppresses ALL retention outreach while a deal is open (the suppressor).
nodes.next: Stage-set omits live Sale stages 5022/5013 — fix before ④ goes live.

nodes.name: Relabel · Relationship Status
nodes.what: Counts paid invoices → advances New Prospect → Returning → New → Repeat (forward-only).

nodes.name: ③ Enrich · ID Heal
nodes.what: Fills the join key from invoice → customer when blank/wrong. Confidence gate; both backfill and daily self-heal.

nodes.name: Pass 2a · Conversion Finalize
nodes.what: Sets Conversion Date; finalizes exact Customer ID, $, geo, New-vs-Return. LIMIT=15/run. The gold-standard enricher.

nodes.name: ① Convert · Sale → Retention
nodes.what: Find-or-create the Retention box (tier, dept, cadence, stage). Sets NEW / ACTIVE / REACTIVATED. 7/5 twin-prevention fix indexes linked-sale CIDs.
nodes.next: Dedup fix (CID backfill + email-domain tier) designed, held for supervised deploy. Streak key is INLINE — edit in n8n UI, not via API.

nodes.name: Daily Recompute (Layer A.1)
nodes.what: Rebuilds #orders, spend, last-order-date, cadence from full Printavo history (21-day occasion clustering, dead-CID re-resolve).
nodes.next: Risks the 300s execution cap on a full pull → partial re-band. Paginate/shard.

nodes.name: Band-Updater
nodes.what: Moves ACTIVE ↔ AT-RISK by cadence (BAND_MULT 1.25×). Never auto-sets INACTIVE.

nodes.name: ④ AT-Risk Save-Touch (Layer B.1)
nodes.what: The outreach: T1 → SAVE CALL task · T2 → SAVE EMAIL task (paste-ready copy) · T3 → skip. Reads ② Guard to mute mid-deal; stamps Save Touch 1.
nodes.next: OFF (inactive + DRY_RUN). The single biggest hole — every save touch is hand-sent today.

nodes.name: Pass 2b · AI Profile + Type
nodes.what: AI fills Profile + the 100-option customer Type.

nodes.name: Form to Printavo
nodes.what: Pushes the web form into Printavo as an order/quote.

nodes.name: Annual Reorder Email (~305 day)
nodes.what: The annual reorder nudge — core to reorder retention.
nodes.next: Firing UNCONFIRMED. Token expires 2026-09-12. Verify + migrate to n8n.

nodes.name: 1st Check-In
nodes.what: First relationship touch on a new bandana customer.

nodes.name: Annual Reorder (/reorderban)
nodes.what: Reorder reach-out on the bandana ladder.
nodes.next: No engine — manual. Overlaps System B's annual email (unreconciled).
